reference: Existing PLEX little-e-front.png robot identity; generated poses then used as reference for parts
license_note: AI-generated project artwork, not a third-party open-source character. Original PLEX identity retained.

prompts.poses: Six poses of the same polished two-head-tall chibi robot: neutral, held aloft, landing, thinking with holographic tablet, explaining, puzzled. Pearl white shell, navy faceplate, glowing cyan details, teal scarf and diamond badge. 3 by 2 contact sheet; transparent background. Preserve the reference robot identity.
prompts.parts: Using the pose sheet as identity reference, make a transparent 4 by 2 equal-cell atlas of isolated finely painted robot parts: empty-face head without fin, torso with scarf without limbs, left arm, right arm, left foot/leg, right foot/leg, antenna fin, holographic tablet. No eyes in faceplate (added as animated vector features in application). No outside glow or cast shadows. Do not assemble the robot.

rendering: Atlas is preserved unchanged. RobotRig.vue clips its separate parts with nested SVG viewBoxes and animates each part. Eyes and mouth are local vectors; no sprite-frame animation or whole-image rocking.
